newsitem.title: USA: Mass. officials examine alleged Kennedy affair.
newsitem.headline: Mass. officials examine alleged Kennedy affair.

text.p: A Massachusetts district attorney said on Friday authorities were examining a newspaper report that Michael Kennedy, son of the late Sen. Robert Kennedy, had had an affair with his children's babysitter.

The Boston Globe, quoting unnamed sources, reported on its front page that Kennedy began a relationship with the babysitter -- now 19 -- when she was 14, and made promises to her that he would leave his wife.

"As a result of information that is contained in the paper, and it is all through unnamed sources at this time, my office and the sexual assault unit of my office is now working with the Cohasset police department ... to conduct a preliminary review of the information that is contained in the Boston Globe," Norfolk County District Attorney Jeffrey Locke said in a brief news conference.
"A preliminary review is not necessarily a full criminal investigation and whether it becomes one depends on what is determined during that initial inquiry," Locke said.
He declined to take questions and said any further comment would be inappropriate.

Kennedy, 39, is head of Citizens Energy Corp., the non-profit group founded by his brother, Representative Joseph Kennedy, a Massachusetts Democrat. He and his wife, Victoria Gifford Kennedy, daughter of sportscaster Frank Gifford, said in a statement last week that they had separated after 16 years of marriage and three children.
The girl was identified as the daughter of June and Paul Verrochi, but her full name was not given.

Michael Kennedy, who lives in the coastal town of Cohasset south of Boston, ran his uncle Sen. Edward Kennedy's re-election campaign in 1994 and has often been rumoured to consider running for Congress or for a statewide office.
His office did not return phone calls seeking comment.

The Globe reported that Victoria Kennedy found her husband and the girl, now a 19-year-old college freshman, in bed in 1995. He explained the incident was caused by a drinking problem, and Kennedy later publicly admitted he had an alcohol dependency and entered a residential rehabilitation programme, the newspaper said.
But Kennedy and the girl were seen meeting in several places around Cohasset last summer, and it was the continuation of the relationship that led to the couple's splitup, the Globe said.
After friends told the Verrochis of the suspected relationship, the girl told them about the affair and stopped seeing him last fall, the Globe said.
The Verrochis were close friends of the Kennedys. Paul Verrochi is the chairman of American Medical Response and was named by Inc. magazine as National Entrepreneur of the Year in 1995.
